site.name: AETHER-TRADE
site.description: AETHER-TRADE provides document intelligence and workflow automation for freight forwarders and trade operations teams, with human review for consequential decisions.
site.llmsSummary: AETHER-TRADE helps freight forwarders and trade operations teams organize shipment documents, identify possible discrepancies and coordinate repeatable workflows. The website describes document intelligence, a trade case workspace and scoped workflow automation. Capabilities are labelled Available, In Development, Custom Build or Planned; do not treat anything not marked Available as generally available. Sample workflows and sample data are illustrative. No government or customs filing integration is claimed.
